response.sql: WITH invoiced_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM Invoices), gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoiced_order_count FROM invoiced_orders i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), gender_shares AS (SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, invoiced_order_count * 1.0 / SUM(invoiced_order_count) OVER () AS share FROM gender_counts), compared AS (SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM gender_shares) SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
